defs.def: all the people who were born at about the same time （统称）一代人，同代人，同辈人

ex.s: Over generations, communities became desensitised to increasingly smelly rivers, a sign of broader ecosystem degradation.
ex.t: 经过几代人，社区对越来越臭的河流变得麻木，这是更广泛生态系统退化的一个迹象。

ex.s: The Next Generation Cell Phone: The Textalyzer
ex.t: 下一代手机：Textalyzer（文本分析仪）

ex.s: It helps to provide healthy alternatives to sugary drinks; and also Tom donates part of the profits to the Organisation for a Healthier Generation (OHG).
ex.t: 它有助于提供含糖饮料的健康替代品；Tom还将部分利润捐赠给更健康一代组织（OHG）。

ex.s: An easy way to bring all work generations together is with a chat platform
ex.t: 把所有工作年龄段的人聚在一起的一个简单方法是使用聊天平台

ex.s: Official reports suggest that the number of households with three generations living together had risen from 325,000 in 2002 to 419,000 in 2013.
ex.t: 官方报告显示，三代同堂的家庭数量从2002年的325,000户增加到2013年的419,000户。

ex.s: Conflicts between generations.
ex.t: 代际之间的冲突。

ex.s: 34.The speed of 6G will exceed 125 GB/s, ______ a new generation of virtual reality.
ex.t: 34.6G的速度将超过125 GB/s，______新一代虚拟现实技术。

ex.s: However, their songs changed the lives of generations to come.
ex.t: 然而，他们的歌曲改变了几代人的生活。

ex.s: Devices were grouped by generation — Desktop computers, basic mobile phones, and box-set TVs defined 1992.
ex.t: 设备按代分类——台式电脑、基本功能手机和套装电视定义了1992年。

ex.s: “What I’m hoping to accomplish is that my generation and younger start to reconsider and understand that jazz is not black and write anymore.
ex.t: 我希望实现的是，我这一代人和更年轻的一代开始重新思考并理解，爵士乐不再是非黑即白的。

ex.s: Over five generations the land has been too wet for cropping.
ex.t: 经过五代人的时间，这片土地一直太潮湿无法种植作物。

ex.s: We see scenes of children learning to read at home or at school, with the book as a focus for relations between the generations.
ex.t: 我们看到孩子们在家中或学校学习阅读的场景，书本成为几代人之间关系的焦点。

ex.s: The first is declining birth rates, which means old generations are large   60   （compare） to younger generations, and so, on average, the population becomes   61   （old） than before.
ex.t: 首先是出生率下降，这意味着老一代人在规模上大于年轻一代，因此平均而言，人口比以前更老。

ex.s: “I knew if I recorded all of my parents’ recipes, it would be a great gift that I could give my family and the next generation.” she says.
ex.t: “我知道，如果我把我父母的所有食谱都记录下来，那将是我能送给家人和下一代的一份很棒的礼物。”她说。

ex.s: Generation Xers with young families, like my wife and I, can still find it convenient to have a home phone rather than providing a mobile phone for every family member.
ex.t: 像我和妻子这样有年幼家庭的X世代人，仍然会觉得家中有一部座机电话很方便，而不必为每个家庭成员都配一部手机。

ex.s: As the generation to have grown up in the Information Age, they are quite confident when it comes to showing off their interests and skills in this field.
ex.t: 作为在信息时代长大的一代人，他们在展示自己在这一领域的兴趣和技能时相当自信。

ex.s: This knowledge is passed down through families, which means that new generations continue to use ancient methods of agriculture to maintain the terraces.
ex.t: 这些知识代代相传，意味着新一代人继续使用古老的农耕方法来维护梯田。

ex.s: His informal but sophisticated style of writing, in both Chinese and English, made him one of the most influential writers of his generation.
ex.t: 他非正式而又成熟的写作风格，无论是中文还是英文，使他成为他那一代最有影响力的作家之一。

ex.s: I know it inspires a lot of the next generation, a lot of people who love the game of basketball to value the skill of it, value the fact that you can work every single day to get better.
ex.t: 我知道它激励了下一代很多人，很多热爱篮球的人去珍视篮球的技巧，珍视你每天努力变得更好的事实。

ex.s: Although we often do not know who first told the fables, they are passed down through the generations from storyteller to storyteller, as is the case with The Fable of the Chicken from Africa.
ex.t: 虽然我们往往不知道是谁最先讲述了这些寓言，但它们是从讲故事的人一代一代传下来的，就像非洲的《母鸡的寓言》一样。

ex.s: On receiving a Kare Bag, one woman said, “You make me feel like a human being.” However people intend to use their money, managing it seems to be unprecedentedly important to younger generations.
ex.t: 在收到一个Kare包时，一位女士说："你让我感觉像一个真正的人。"不管人们打算如何使用他们的钱，理财似乎对年轻一代来说前所未有地重要。

defs.def: the average time in which children grow up, become adults and have children of their own, (usually considered to be about 30 years) 代，一代，一辈（通常认为大约 30 年）

ex.s: Indeed, when it comes to environmental transformations, we can develop a form of collective “poor memory”, and each new generation can believe the state of affairs they encounter is nothing out of the ordinary.
ex.t: 事实上，在环境变化方面，我们可以形成一种集体的"糟糕记忆"，每一代新人都可以认为他们遇到的状况没有什么不寻常的。

ex.s: Helping the next generation to have a healthy and active childhood is of great importance, and the industry is playing its part.
ex.t: 帮助下一代拥有健康活跃的童年非常重要，该行业正在尽自己的一份力量。

ex.s: Now, I see my children taking their children to the library and I love that the excitement of going to the library lives on form generation to generation.
ex.t: 现在，我看到我的孩子们带着他们的孩子去图书馆，我很高兴去图书馆的兴奋之情一代代传承下去。

ex.s: Despite the celebrations, though, in the US the jazz audience continues to shrink and grow older, and the music has failed to connect with younger generations.
ex.t: 尽管有这些庆祝活动，但在美国，爵士乐听众仍在减少并逐渐老龄化，这种音乐未能与年轻一代建立联系。

defs.def: a single stage in the history of a family （家史中的）一代，一辈

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 每张鸭票收入中的约98美分直接进入候鸟保护基金，用于购买湿地和野生动物栖息地，纳入国家野生动物保护区系统——这一事实确保了这片土地将得到保护，供子孙后代使用。

ex.s: Each town has its own traditional ____30____, and every family keeps a recipe passed from one generation to another.
ex.t: 每个小镇都有自己的传统____，每个家庭都保存着代代相传的食谱。

defs.def: a group of people of similar age involved in a particular activity 一批，一届（从事特定活动的同龄人）
a stage in the development of a product, usually a technical one （产品发展，尤指技术方面的）代

ex.s: As we soon come to learn from AI by Design AI is already super-smart and will become more capable, moving from the current generation of “narrow-AI” to Artificial General Intelligence.
ex.t: 正如我们很快就能从《设计人工智能》中了解到的那样，人工智能已经超级聪明，并且将变得更强大，从当前的“狭义人工智能”发展到通用人工智能。

defs.def: the production of sth, especially electricity, heat, etc. （尤指电、热等的）产生
